requirements.name: Alexandru Ioan Cuza University of Iasi

academic.academic_summary_notes: Consult the online course catalogue for available courses. Many programmes/specialisations offer courses in English or French while other faculties teach in Romanian; international students receive tutorials and supervision in English and Romanian-language courses run only if at least 10 students sign up.

housing_and_logistics.housing_details: University campus accommodation (student residences such as C5) is available and requires an accommodation contract plus a certificate from the student residence (e.g. C5). Private housing requires a renting contract certified at the Iasi General Directorate of Public Finances or a landlord's declaration and real estate contract (translated into Romanian). Documents related to accommodation and immigration should be submitted within 30–60 days of arrival.
housing_and_logistics.medical_and_insurance_details: European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) or private insurance is accepted for visa/residence formalities. Foreign citizens aged 26+ must have health insurance for residence permit extension (use the same policy used for the visa with an authorized translation); those younger than 26 do not need a medical insurance for extension. A medical certificate ('clinic sanatos') is also required for residence procedures.
housing_and_logistics.logistics_summary_notes: Students need the university acceptance/nomination and a certificate issued by the institution for visa and residence permit applications; submit documents to the General Inspectorate for Immigration in Iaşi within 30–60 days of arrival. Residence permit applications are typically processed within 30 days (may be extended by up to 15 days).

student_integration.language_course_details: A Romanian language course is offered only if at least 10 students enrol; participation is queried during the orientation meeting. No cost information provided. Tutorials and academic supervision for international students are provided in English and students may complete assignments and be examined in English.
student_integration.integration_summary_notes: An orientation meeting and an initial meeting with the Erasmus academic coordinator are provided; students receive regular tutorials and individual meetings with coordinators and professors to support integration.

analysis.general_fit_reasoning: University of Cyprus has a cohesive suburban campus feel making it easy to meet classmates; Nicosia provides museums and a pleasant Mediterranean climate; social life is solid but less of an Erasmus party hub than major Western European cities; overall costs fit the stated maximum.

academic.academic_summary_notes: Full-time study equals 30 ECTS per semester (60 ECTS per year); no minimum number of credits is required. student_integration.language_course_details: Italian language courses are recommended for exchange students (Level B1 recommended for courses in Italian); Level B2 in English recommended for courses in English. No certificate is required for exchange programme application.
student_integration.integration_summary_notes: Politecnico promotes integration through a buddy system and welcome events; students are encouraged to consider Italian language courses to support participation in Italian-taught classes.
